The integrated LED light string provides an eye-catching glow, while the discreet wire blends with the greenery for a seamless appearance. Made from high-quality plastic with natural-looking stems, the garland is durable, odour-free and resistant to folding. Its flexible design can be twisted and shaped to suit windows, tabletops, staircases, hallways, fireplaces, walls and other decorative spaces. Suitable for Christmas, Valentine's Day and other seasonal displays in homes, gardens, bedrooms, shops, cafés and restaurants. Specifications: 2.7 m decorative Christmas garland, high-quality plastic construction, holly, baubles, flowers and leaf decorations, glitter-finished details, integrated LED light string, discreet matching wire, flexible and shapeable design, odour-free construction, and suitable for indoor and outdoor decorative displays.
